notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {3}.
description:
Activate a permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Burst of Energy without paying its mana cost, targeting Isochron Scepter.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, creating a copy of Burst of Energy, targeting the permanent that can tap to produce at least {3}.
Resolve both Burst of Energy copies, untapping Isochron Scepter and the permanent.
Repeat.
